key_insight: Lean 4.0 maintenance practices reduced welding-machine downtime in a continuous steel galvanizing line by a reported 375 minutes per year.
engineering_relevance: Standardized maintenance and operator training can improve welding-machine reliability and support production continuity in steel galvanizing.
method: Empirical case study of a galvanizing-line welding machine.
Introduced a machine checklist and staff training.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a 375-minute annual reduction in total welding-machine downtime against a historical baseline of 496 minutes per year attributed specifically to welding-disc failures.
watch_item: The single-machine case and differing downtime scopes limit generalization; the abstract does not isolate the contribution of digital technologies.
paper_title: Lean maintenance 4.0: Enhancing welding machine reliability in steel galvanizing processes
